rdfs:label: nameMap
rdfs:comment: Language-tagged variants of an ActivityStreams Object's `name` — keys are BCP 47 language tags, values are the localised name strings. A JSON-LD `@language`-map alias for `as:name`, not a separate RDF property.
notes: JSON-LD alias: in the AS2 context `nameMap` is `as:name` with `@container: @language`, so in RDF it is just language-tagged `as:name` literals; it has no IRI of its own. Note that `urn:solid:name` is foaf:name, not as:name. Provide alongside (or instead of) `as:name` when the Object has translations. Standard fediverse pattern for multilingual content. Clients SHOULD pick the best match for the user's locale; servers MAY mirror one entry into `as:name` as a fallback for non-aware consumers. The example carries an inline context term with `@container: @language` so the map actually expands. It carries no owl:sameAs of its own: the RDF property is `https://www.w3.org/ns/activitystreams#name`, which has no registry term (`urn:solid:name` is foaf:name); this term only names the JSON-LD alias.

history.note: owl:sameAs -> as:name (nameMap is the AS2 context's @language-map alias); example gets inline @language context and corrected title; seeAlso foaf-based urn:solid:name -> as:name. owl:sameAs moved to seeAlso (one registry term per upstream IRI).
